notes.title: "Dungeon Run" Mode Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Our first major update is available for Brave Hand, and it brings an all-new game mode! Inspired by your feedback requesting a longer strategic game, I developed the "Dungeon Run" mode that lets you build a combined score across multiple games. You enter the Guardian's Dungeon, and survive through a roguelike experience where your health is your draw deck. Survive until you run out of cards, and find camping checkpoints to replenish your health along the way. Give it a try and send me your feedback in the forums -- if it becomes popular I'd [b]love [/b]to expand it further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31648020/74f0e70cb64fdb837bf7cede89cb9479c4a1ff35.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31648020/538219bfba6d32f7cdb7f2c8ea8756118b1e8721.png[/img]

This update also addresses the community's most requested bug fixes and translation changes since launch. We're so excited to see the reaction to the game. If you're enjoying it, please drop us a positive [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/763340/Brave_Hand/]review on our Steam Store Page[/url]!

[h2]Full Update Change List (v0.57):[/h2]
-New Mode "Dungeon Run": play through multiple games to build a combined score as you dive further into the Guardian's dungeon. 
-Added Leaderboards and best score tracking for Zen Mode and Dungeon Run.
-Fixed stat tracking issue that prevented the "5 Clears" achievement from being completed.
-Added Dungeon Run "How To Play" page (note: not translated from english yet).
-New intro tips on your first games of Zen Mode and Dungeon Run.
-New card icon for Jacks (11).
-Dungeon Run has additional 2X multiplier pile bonuses, and added support to modify pile bonuses per mode.
-New end of game screen formatting for Dungeon Run mode.

[h2]Translation Bug Fixes:[/h2]
-Fixed font size issue with How To Play text in Chinese.
-Fixed end of game screen spacing problems in all languages.
-Variety of fixes across languages, including some missing info and formatting on the end of game screen.
